headline: Gutter Sees Fresh Flurry as Palantine Berm Quickens
war_summary: Since the last filing three hours ago, Gutter has quickened again with eleven changes in two hours and fifty-one on the day centred on Kuoppa, Lost Kaivo and Salaoja Road, its tally now four Warden, one Colonial and two neutral. Palantine Berm has sharpened to eight in two hours and twenty-four on the day about Vendett and Underlook, holding one Warden to six Colonial, while Weathered Expanse has eased to two in two hours though twenty-nine on the day about Spirit Watch, Necropolis and Crow's Nest, now five Warden, one Colonial and three neutral. Godcrofts stirs anew with two in two hours and eleven on the day about Isawa and Argosa at one to eight, whereas Marban Hollow, Nevish Line and Linn Mercy record nothing in the last two hours despite seventeen, nineteen and five changes on the day. Callahan's Passage still reports the heaviest daily toll above eleven thousand Colonial and near eight thousand Warden casualties and Stonecradle above two thousand each, neither with a recorded change.
